create_PddlAction: create a PddlAction with name, parameters, preconditions, and postconditions for PDDL planning
apply_PddlAction_apply_if_true: apply a PddlAction post-condition to the simulator if its pre-condition evaluates to true
test_PddlAction_is_precond_satisfied_fro: test if a PddlAction preconditions are satisfied from a given list of predicates
refactor_PddlAction_set_param_values: refactor a PddlAction by binding parameters to PDDL entities and substituting into conditions
clone_PddlAction_clone: clone a PddlAction to create a copy with cloned preconditions and postconditions
